newsitem.title: USA: Zapata sees Q4 $5 mln net gain from sale.
newsitem.headline: Zapata sees Q4 $5 mln net gain from sale.

text.p: Zapata Corp, reporting higher operating income in the third quarter ended June 30, said Wednesday it expected to post a $5 million net gain in its fourth quarter from selling its oil and gas interests in Bolivia.
The company said it completed the sale of its Bolivian interests to Tesoro Petroleum Corp's Bolivian subsidiary for $18.8 million and the assumption of certain liabilities on July 11.
Zapata Wednesday reported net income of $4.8 million, or $0.18 a share, for the quarter ended June 30, compared with a $1.2 million net, or $0.04 a share, the year before.
Excluding contributions from its Bolivian interests, Zapata's net increased to $2.9 million, or $0.11 a share, for the quarter, compared with a $1 million net, or $0.03 a share, the year before.
The company's operating income increased to $5 million for the quarter from $3.2 million a year ago. Zapata attributed the rise to higher prices and sales of its fish meal and fish oil products.
Zapata's stock hit a new 52-week high of 6-5/16 Wednesday, and was trading at 6-1/8 in the late afternoon, up 1/4.
